supported_delta: A thin deterministic public-input adapter may preserve the compatible-goal set after WP804 ABSTAIN and map it into existing Hyperposition alternatives for targeted discrimination. This is a research projection only.
important_negative_result: The initially suspected coarse identifiability bug in WP804 is not present after its merged repair; exact goals are already forbidden when public evidence does not uniquely identify one candidate.
falsifier: Matched held-out cases must share the same binary ABSTAIN outcome but require different useful probes because their public-compatible goal sets differ. If preserving the set does not improve probe selection/downstream correctness over binary ABSTAIN, or duplicates an existing derived Hyperposition path, reject the adapter.
